answer: Here is one mechanism that works: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because horizon only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, mesa is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any voyage approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
